pages.overview.title: Travel price comparison
pages.overview.lead: We query more than 20 sources in parallel – flights, hotels, ferries and cruises – and show the cheapest price with final price, tax status and source status. No markup, no sign-up.
pages.overview.step1: All sources at once: each source is queried directly with the provider – no intermediary markup.
pages.overview.step2: Final price instead of a teaser price: where the source states it, we show the price including baggage and taxes. If there is no evidence, it says “not available”.
pages.overview.step3: Honest gaps: blocked sources and implausible prices (e.g. €0.01) are discarded and disclosed – not smoothed over.
pages.overview.step4: Referral instead of sale: bookings are made with the provider; we only refer.

pages.alarms.title: Price alerts
pages.alarms.lead: An alert is a watcher configuration: budget, low point and price drop are evaluated by the existing watcher (alerts/watcher.py). The rules are firmly anchored in the watcher.
